scope: fixed installed baseline vs newly verified candidate; hardware-local paired comparison; model classes not pooled
normal_series: spec4+MTP+k8v4; exact pack/tokenizer/views/argv/env fixed within series
series_separation: blob diagnostics ON pilot excluded from performance inference
release_boundary_gate: 130048+1024 and131071+1 wait P02 capacity contract; no small-capacity substitution; no silent fit_max_tokens reservation shortening

cross_validation.group: original task/prompt family; all lengths/positions/technical repetitions stay together
cross_validation.stratification: task category,language,position,length where feasible; deterministic seed recorded
cross_validation.heldout: score held-out groups; all build/profile choices frozen first; if tuning occurs use train folds only and separately held-out final test
cross_validation.disclosure: fixed executables require no model fitting; label evaluation folds honestly; fold scores/repetitions are not independent observations

pairing: same exact token IDs, weights/pack/tokenizer,capacity,reserve,KV/views,device/cache regime,output rubric; randomized balanced AB/BA order; failed/unmatched runs retained and block pass

statistics.primary_effect: paired median difference and95% task-cluster bootstrap CI; relative speedup plus absolute timings
statistics.primary_test: two-sided paired label-swap/sign-flip permutation at independent task group; exact if feasible else finite seeded Monte Carlo with add-one correction
statistics.quality_binary: Use group-level paired label-swap as primary. If McNemar is reported, predefine one binary outcome per original task family per executable (all required variants must pass); exactly one discordance pair per independent group, never per length/position/repetition.
statistics.noninferiority: nonsignificance is not equivalence; independently meet predeclared quality/SLO thresholds
statistics.latency: stream token timestamps for TTFT/ITL; engine DONE timings are separate metrics and cannot substitute
statistics.failure: no p-value/performance verdict when valid pairs absent, source/binary identities unresolved or131072 capacity fails
statistics.low_n: raw n/CI and small-sample limits; no stable p95 claim from one pilot
statistics.aggregation: Within each prompt variant aggregate technical repeats by median; within original family give variants equal prespecified weight and aggregate by median; equal weight per independent family. Effects and bootstrap resample whole families. Folds and technical repetitions do not increase independent n. Report n_family, n_variant, n_repeat separately. Stratified length-specific reports retain original grouping.
statistics.permutation_statistic: absolute mean of paired family differences; two-sided family sign flips; descriptive effect and bootstrap use paired median differences

quality_reference: same weights independently validated reference runtime and frozen scoring; absent reference/PPL/logits remain NOT_RUN, never substitute sentinel recall for full quality
resources: single heavy job; no budgets expanded from resource availability
execution: NOT_RUN on measured pairs; tools/perf131k/statistics.py validated only with synthetic CPU fixtures
revision: v4; schema2 binds analyzer source and reports fixed grouped evaluation folds; no measurements run
full_qualification_stages: 131072-capacity full gate after P02/P16; not replaced by initial pilot

full_qualification_gate.boundary_tests: 130048+1024 and131071+1 after P02; separate from pilot

offline_executor.command: py -3.12 -B -m tools.perf131k.statistics manifest.json runs.json --frozen-sha256 <previously recorded canonical SHA256>
offline_executor.hash: SHA256 of UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=True, separators=(comma,colon), allow_nan=False; digest() helper; record independently before collection. Self-rehash after observing runs is not a freeze.
offline_executor.manifest: schema=2; analysis_sha256=SHA256 of the frozen statistics.py source artifact; data_kind=synthetic|measured; stage=pilot|full; capacity=131072; integer seed; bootstrap_draws/permutation_draws 100..100000; arms baseline/candidate each source_sha256 and binary_sha256; shared_identity_sha256; endpoints mapping metric name to lower|higher; families mapping original-family ID to {fold:0..4}, all five folds represented; pairs list.
offline_executor.shared_identity_contents: Before collection freeze model/pack/tokenizer contents, capacity, KV/views, argv/env, device/cache regime, scoring rubric and series (cold/first/warm; trace; diagnostic settings). Shared identity SHA256 binds this external canonical record. Model classes and series never pooled.
offline_executor.run_fields: Every pair field plus arm, status=PASS, manifest_sha256, identity=arm identity, shared_identity_sha256, capacity, data_kind, raw_artifact_sha256, metrics with exactly all frozen endpoint names and finite positive values. Full additionally generated_steps>=512, independent_receipt_sha256, processed_input_tokens=kv_progress_tokens=recurrence_progress_tokens=126000.
offline_executor.supported_metrics: Positive timing/throughput endpoints only. Stream TTFT/ITL and engine DONE must be different frozen endpoints. Binary quality, PPL, quality/SLO decisions and stratified score reports are separate NOT_RUN gates.
offline_executor.resampling: Median repeats within variant; median equally weighted variants within original family. Equal family weight. Whole-family percentile bootstrap 95% CI, linear quantiles. Exact family sign flips through 16 independent groups; otherwise seeded finite Monte Carlo with add-one correction. Holm across entire frozen endpoint map. Permutation tie comparison uses relative tolerance1e-12 with zero absolute tolerance to preserve metric-unit scale invariance.
offline_executor.outputs: stdout JSON, exit 0 for analysis, exit 2 BLOCKED; all invalid/failed/missing/duplicate/unregistered/mismatched records block all endpoint statistics. Synthetic status DESIGN_NOT_RUN. Valid measured records status ANALYZED means offline calculations only; performance_verdict always NOT_EVALUATED. Includes verified analysis_sha256 and per-endpoint evaluation_fold_summaries with family IDs/counts and paired family medians; fold counts do not increase independent n.
offline_executor.trust_boundary: Normalized collector records and digest strings are inputs, not independent proof of their contents. Verify raw artifacts, source-to-binary provenance, collection chronology/freeze, independent receipt and quality/reference gates before any performance claim. No automatic adoption verdict.
offline_executor.evaluation_folds: One immutable fold per original family, all variants/repeats inherit it. Five evaluation folds, no fitting or tuning performed here; fold scores are not independent observations. Stratification must be reviewed in the frozen external map. Reports five fixed grouped evaluation summaries; no train-fold fitting/tuning or independently held-out final test is implemented. Freeze the analyzer source and Python environment before collection; schema1 manifests are rejected.
offline_executor.protocol_minimums: Executor computes offline statistics; warmups, minimum ten alternating warm pairs, cold runs, retrieval/practical task counts, boundary checks and 32turn/2h stability remain independent qualification checks. Successful analysis does not establish those checks.
